Special Branch Registry
23rd September 1941.

SURVEY OF THE WORKINGS OF THE SPECIAL
BRANCH REGISTRY

The main workings of the Registry comprise
of the indexing of reports, documents and correspondence
relating to politics, labour and other general subjects,
including film and stage play censorship, the regis-
tration of newspapers and public bodies. The filing
of the above subjects in such a manner as to be referred
to at a moment's notice. The Registry is also
required to assist other sections of the Special Branch
as in the censorship of newspapers, dispatching of report
letters, etc.

The Registry staff consists of one Foreign
Clerical Assistant, one 1st Grade Clerk, one 2nd Grade
Clerk and one 3rd Grade Clerk, an Assistant and a Cadet.
The duties of the above are as follows:-

Clerical Assistant

Supervision of all work done in the Registry,
the indexing and classifying of all confidential reports
and documents on all subjects, scrutinizing and distri-
buting of all reports and correspondences dealing with
all the Special Branch sections.

1st Grade Clerk

Indexing of reports, correspondences and
documents relating to politics, labour and other
general subjects in which the Special Branch are
interested, keeping administrative and other files in
such a manner as to be immediately obtainable by
referring to the index.

特务科档案室工作综述

档案室的主要工作包括对涉及政治、劳工及其他一般主题（包括电影和舞台剧审查、报纸及公共团体注册）的报告、文件和信件进行索引。对上述主题的归档方式需确保能随时查阅。档案室还需协助特务科其他部门的工作，如报纸审查、发送报告信函等。

档案室职员包括一名外籍文书助理、一名一级文员、一名二级文员和一名三级文员，以及一名助理和一名见习员。上述人员职责如下：-

文书助理

监督档案室所有工作，对所有主题的机密报告和文件进行索引和分类，审查并分发涉及特务科各部门的所有报告和信件。

一级文员

对特务科关注的政治、劳工及其他一般主题的报告、信件和文件进行索引，以通过索引即可立即获取的方式管理行政及其他档案。

2nd Grade Clerk
Indexing of reports on film and stage play
censorship, reports on newspapers such as indecent
publications, change of editors, etc., newspaper
registration and registration of public bodies, extra
duty, part-time censorship of Chinese newspapers. (See
note)
Note: This clerk does censorship duty every afternoon
excepting week-ends for S.B, his duties are then
taken over by 3rd Grade Clerk.

3rd Grade Clerk
In charge of filing. Keeping records of
movements of Special Branch Registry files and making
lists of files belonging to other registries passing
through this office and recording them in exit books
to see that they reach their destinations against
signatures. Replacing 2nd Grade Clerk when the latter
is on censorship duty.

One Assistant
Despatch of correspondence. In charge of
stationery. Assisting in filing and keeping of Police
Orders, memos, circulars, foreign press clipping and
other elementary office work such as typing etc.
Note: This Assistant has been attached to the Registry
since December 1939 and does clerical work. It
has been previously suggested that he be
incorporated into the regular staff as a clerk.

注：该文员除周末外，每天下午为特务科执行审查任务，其职责届时由三级文员接替。

三级文员
负责归档。记录特务科档案室档案的流转情况，编制经过本办公室的其他档案室的档案清单，并在出库登记簿中记录，以确保档案经签收后送达目的地。在二级文员执行审查任务时接替其工作。

一名助理
发送信件。负责文具管理。协助归档及保管警务命令、备忘录、通函、外文报刊剪报及其他基础办公工作，如打字等。

Report on Card Indexing. - Special Branch Registry.

Owing to the increase in reports and statements for filing, it has been found that the present system of card indexing is inadequate to cope with it, also the efficiency of the Registry is being affected. It is therefore suggested that the following change be made in the system.

Under the old system, cards were divided into alphabetical order as follows :-

i.e. "A" is divided into 4 sections, such as AA to AK, AL to AM, AN to AR and AS to AZ, this meaning that all names or subjects spelt with the first two letters similar to the first two letters in any of the sections are entered in that respective section. It is found that in some of these sections there are as many as 60 cards, and in one case as many as 110. Having so many cards in one section has caused considerable waste of time in the indexing of files and the finding of same. This, it is pointed out, is due to having to look through the many cards.

The suggestion made to remedy the above is to further divide the section as follows :-

i.e. have "A" sub-divided into 26 sections, for each letter of the alphabet, this will mean a decrease in the amount of cards used in each section, thus reducing the time wasted in looking through and will greatly assist in making the indexing easier, besides increasing the efficiency of the Registry.

This suggestion does not only cover names but also general subjects.

（签名）
（批：OA. Personality）

1941年4月15日。

关于卡片索引的报告。- 特务科档案室。

由于待归档的报告和陈述增加，发现现有的卡片索引系统不足以应对，档案室的效率也受到影响。因此建议对系统进行以下更改。

在旧系统下，卡片按字母顺序划分如下：-

即“A”分为4个部分，如 AA 至 AK，AL 至 AM，AN 至 AR 和 AS 至 AZ，这意味着所有前两个字母与任一部分中前两个字母相似的名字或主题都录入相应的部分。发现在某些部分中有多达60张卡片，甚至有一例多达110张。在一个部分中拥有如此多的卡片导致在索引档案和查找档案时浪费了大量时间。指出这是由于必须翻阅大量卡片所致。

为解决上述问题提出的建议是进一步细分该部分如下：-

即把“A”细分为26个部分，对应字母表的每个字母，这将意味着每个部分使用的卡片数量减少，从而减少翻阅浪费的时间，并将大大有助于使索引更容易，同时提高档案室的效率。

Subject................. Personnel Estimates-1940.

Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by ....... C.A. Richards.

I beg to suggest that there be included in
Personnel Estimates for 1940 an application for one
Chinese clerk, to be attached to Special Branch
Registry.

In explanation of this request, I beg to
state that the present Chinese staff of the Registry
consists of :-
1) A clerk working on the general index.
2) A clerk working on the Film Censorship index
and the record of movements of files.
3) A despatch clerk.
4) A cadet.

Until about six months ago, this staff was
sufficient to cope with the volume of work passing
through the Registry, and keep the files in a fair
condition. Since that time, however, the volume of
work has swollen so that additional staff is required
if things are to run freely and the files kept in
proper order.

The additional clerk applied for, if allotted,
will be employed in arranging and sub-dividing of files
and their general maintenance, a task which is at
present shared by all members of the Registry staff,
and which greatly impairs efficiency and smooth
working of this office.

D.C.(Special Branch).
C.A. Richards
